'''Gasch N'doss''' was a [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. When he was a teenage boy, he was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]]. Abused and desensitized by his Zygerrian captors since early life, Gasch was practical and unapologetic when it came to protecting his fellow slaves.<ref name="Friends Like These" />
